docs-bot: automated link-scan found 1 new 404 under /kb/runbooks — /kb/runbooks/resize-cluster

maya: heads-up — when I preview that runbook in Safari the top header image is missing and the inline preview errors with a 302 -> 404 redirect. chrome preview looks fine. :thinking_face:

olivia: that sounds like the signed-cookie CDN thing. Safari blocks third-party cookies unless SameSite=None; our signed-url flow sometimes falls back to a redirect that loses the token. quick workaround: swap the header image to the absolute public CDN path or add a plain fallback link under the image so previews don't break.

liam: can you paste the failing URL pattern? I can open a tiny PR if we agree on the fix.

maya: failing path in the page is `!/assets/headers/resize-cluster.png` which expands to our internal signed-url service: `https://cdn.redwood-inference.com/signed/...?u=/assets/headers/resize-cluster.png`. Safari shows a 302 to the auth gateway then 404.

olivia: suggested edit (2 lines) — put this under the header in markdown so previews fall back cleanly:

```
![resize runbook header](/assets/headers/resize-cluster.png)

If the image does not load in your browser, open the raw image: https://static.redwood-inference.com/assets/headers/resize-cluster.png
```

olivia: that keeps the human-facing fallback while we investigate long-term signed-url headers.

liam: cool. i'll open the PR now and ping for a 1-line change CR. do we have an owner for this runbook?

maya: i think sam (PM) is the current card owner, but content ownership is fuzzy — tagging them for sign-off @sam

sam (PM): yep i'm aware of this runbook. go ahead and patch the fallback, no product changes needed. thanks for catching. :thumbsup:

liam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4728 — tiny md change and a note in the commit message about Safari preview 302->404. pinging @olivia for quick review when you have a minute.

olivia: saw it, will review tomorrow morning (PST). if nobody objects i'll merge once CI passes. :eyes:

maya: thanks — quick checklist for followups:
- liam: add the fallback and commit (done)
- olivia: quick CR (pending)
- eng-infra: can you follow up on signed-url SameSite headers? (cc @liam for infra ticket)

liam: created infra ticket: https://redwood-internal/issue/INFRA-1932 — brief description + repro steps. added screenshots from Safari preview.

maya: perfect. marking this resolved for docs sprint board once PR is merged.

sam (PM): no blockers from PM side. thanks all.

(reacts: maya :thumbsup:, olivia :eyes:, sam (PM) :white_check_mark:)
